test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiomatic expression to fill in the blank.

Our Director took a meeting and asked us to express our views on ___________ of the new HR policy.
solution: The correct answer is** 'Option 2' i.e. 'the pros and cons'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"the pros and cons"** refers to the advantages and disadvantages of something.("भला - बुरा") • **- Example:** Before making any decision, it is important to weigh the pros and cons. • **"The pros and cons"** is the correct phrase to use in this context because it suggests evaluating both positive and negative aspects of the new HR policy. • **Example: **The team discussed the pros and cons of implementing flexible working hours. Therefore, the **correct answer **is- the pros and cons. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **"The bandwagon"** ** **refers to joining others in doing something that has become fashionable or popular.(कुछ ऐसा करने में दूसरों के साथ शामिल होना है जो फैशनेबल या लोकप्रिय हो गया है।) • **Example**: Many companies jumped on the bandwagon of remote working during the pandemic. • **"The hook"** usually refers to something that is designed to catch someone's attention or interest.(कुछ ऐसा जो किसी का ध्यान या रुचि आकर्षित करने के लिए बनाया गया हो) • **Example**: The catchy chorus of the song serves as a hook to keep listeners engaged. • **"The ups and downs"** refers to the positive and negative events or periods in life or a situation.(जीवन या किसी स्थिति में सकारात्मक और नकारात्मक घटनाएं या अवधि।) • **Example**: Every business experiences its ups and downs, but perseverance is key to success. 21c:Tad3, The correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. 'second wind'.**
